hooks.command: mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/ts-eslint-proxy.mjs" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/ts-eslint-proxy.mjs" && chmod +x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/ts-eslint-proxy.mjs" && PID_FILE="${HOME}/.claude/ts-eslint-lsp.pid" && if [ -f "${PID_FILE}" ]; then RUNNING_PID=$(cat "${PID_FILE}" 2>/dev/null) && if [ -n "${RUNNING_PID}" ]; then RUNNING_SCRIPT=$(ps -ww -p "${RUNNING_PID}" -o args= 2>/dev/null | grep -o '[^ ]*eslint-aggregator.mjs' || true) && if [ "${RUNNING_SCRIPT}" != "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/eslint-aggregator.mjs" ]; then kill "${RUNNING_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true && for i in 1 2 3 4; do sleep 0.5 && kill -0 "${RUNNING_PID}" 2>/dev/null || break; done && kill -9 "${RUNNING_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true && rm -f "${PID_FILE}"; fi; else rm -f "${PID_FILE}"; fi; fi && if [ ! -f "${PID_FILE}" ]; then mkdir -p "${HOME}/.claude/logs" && ESLINT_IDE_PORT=7475 node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/eslint-aggregator.mjs" >> "${HOME}/.claude/logs/eslint-aggregator.log" 2>&1 & fi
